title: Fix Desktop UI/UX issues
description:
The Tauri desktop UI needs UX improvements:
- Loading indicator placement/behavior
- Form layout and spacing
- Better feedback on command execution
- Overall polish and responsiveness

title: Keygen tool: Add --no-save flag and implement recover command
description:
Added missing keygen functionality:

1. **--no-save / --print-only flag**: Generate keypairs without saving to disk - displays mnemonic in console
2. **recover --mnemonic**: Actually implemented recovery from mnemonic (was placeholder)
3. **recover with save options**: Can save recovered keypair to file or just display

New usage:
- `demostools keygen new --no-save` - Generate and display only
- `demostools keygen recover --mnemonic "..." --no-save` - Recover and display
- `demostools keygen recover --mnemonic "..." --outfile ./keypair.json` - Recover and save

title: Fix config "set" command - not a valid action
description:
The config tool in the UI shows "set" as an option, but it's not implemented in the actual CLI config module.

Location: tools/modules/config.ts
UI shows: set, get, set-rpc, list-rpcs (from ui-app/src/main.ts)
Actual CLI only supports: show, init, apply-env, use-config

Need to either:
1. Implement set/get/set-rpc/list-rpcs in config.ts
2. Or remove these options from the UI
